sources/legacy_armor_later.json.objective: 為 C-11～C-21 逐套保留原裝甲身份，提供與 Halo 非士官長裝甲融合前的來源稽核。
sources/legacy_armor_later.json.ownership: Only this scratch JSON. No runtime/art-gallery mutation.

source_policy.material_restoration: capture script instantiates original player.gltf and calls Visuals._restore_original_materials(original); the original pass copies those original meshes/materials, not assets/equipment_refined.
source_policy.screenshot_kind: 既有 Godot 3D 檢視器使用還原的原模型／原材質的畫面；不是生成美術，也不是原發行版程式的歷史截圖。
source_policy.display_limitations: 既有 front、side、rear 檔名標示相機角度；模型仍在持槍待機轉身姿態，所以 rear 圖實際偏側面、side 圖更偏背側；不能宣稱正交三視定稿。光照會影響觀察色。
source_policy.no_backpack_inference: capture script explicitly hides backpack_socket. These armor images do not define any original backpack; backpacks must use independent bag references.
source_policy.prior_generated_excluded: docs/art/armor_concepts_v2/images、armor_concepts_thunder_style_v1/images、original_armors_v1/images 均未作原遊戲素材來源。

sources/halo_matches_08_14.json.scope: C-08–C-14 原裝甲 × Halo 非士官長款式的實圖配對稽核
rules: 只有實際看過的原圖特徵才能稱為參考觀察。
禁止士官長及 Mark IV/V/VI/VII 主盔；CQC/EOD 是命名的多人遊戲變體，不能換成通用 Mark 主盔。
Halo 顏色不覆蓋 Star Warfare 原裝甲身份；保留原款配色與少量特徵再融合。
背部動力甲是穿戴結構參考；不可自行宣稱它對應 Star Warfare 獨立背包 ID。
新圖仍需重新安排輪廓、比例、板件、面罩、接縫，不能只把兩張圖拼起來。
sources/halo_matches_08_14.json.primary_source_policy: 官方原遊戲模型、官方網站渲染或製作人公開的原畫；Halopedia 用於取得檔案和原始作者出處。CQC 的補充四視圖是社群用 Bungie 原資產排版，已明列；不是 fanart 或 cosplay。
technical_limitations: c08_engineer_game3.png 的完整大圖透過 view_image 遭遇工具 base64 讀取錯誤；改下載並實看同公開頁面提供的 800px 伺服器縮圖，原檔仍保留。
Engineer 僅有側背模組可見；Perseus/EOD 無同款背面可見，兩者不能聲稱已核對完整後視。

matches.source_kind: Official Halo 4 / Halo Waypoint render, confirmed against official Interactive Guide screenshot; supplementary actual MCC Halo 4 gameplay screenshot.

observed.helmet: 圓冠中間寬槽；正面四個獨立圓形光譜節點、兩側機構框，下面連續環形下顎管。原款沒有普通寬面罩，融合時應主動保留 Atom 的玻璃面窗。
observed.chest: 兩根向肩頸延伸的厚長胸帶，胸前一個集中維修模組，下胸收窄；肩殼低，胸帶、前臂、腹部之间露出蜂巢紋軟衣。
observed.back: 主圖和遊戲側視看得到高於肩後的方長模組，外側有 U 形長槽與頂端網狀通風面；沒有取得正後方圖，不能描述背面中線。
observed.match_reason: Atom 的額頭多點感測與 Engineer 分散光學節點直接對應；胸帶／後肩模組能把 Atom 長肩領片轉成有用途的感測器護架。

matches.integration_en: Fuse original Star Warfare Atom with the observed Halo 4 Engineer construction. Keep Atom's violet and steel-blue armor, cyan glass visor, exactly three small cyan status points above and beside the brow, and paired rear-swept shoulder fins. Borrow Engineer's segmented engineering collar, serviceable chest cartridge, round side sensor fittings, and visible woven undersuit. Do not replace the visor with Engineer's four camera-like eyes: move the sensor language onto the brow and temple housings around one real human visor. Shorten Atom's shoulder fins into paired sensor guards connected to the rear carrier. Make the chest and hips follow a human torso with normal neck, elbows, knees and five-finger gloves. Rear carrier side pods may take Engineer's vented rectangular profile, but its unseen center-back details must be newly designed and identified as original. Retain Atom's purple-blue-cyan palette instead of the orange reference coating; change plate seams and module layout so the result is a new coherent suit.

references.note: Public server thumbnail; original downloaded separately; no local image modification.

matches.source_kind: Official Halo Waypoint customization renderer and Kory Lynn Hubbell production concept.
matches.creator: Kory Lynn Hubbell

observed.helmet: 頭盔眉緣下壓，連續玻璃面窗形成中央下凹 V 形；圓冠上有後掠的加厚冠片，護頰分成上下兩層，黑色短下顎清楚。
observed.chest: 高開口護領围住可見軟頸，胸板依肋骨向中央斜收；肩甲和前臂由多片短甲叠成，肘部留出軟衣。
observed.back: 製作原畫有後視：上背中央長尖盾形殼，兩側長後肩框，下接多層 V 形片；腰後另外一塊 U 形短板。
observed.match_reason: Pegasus 的深 V 面罩、尖眉和寬肩，與 Helioskrill 的 V 面窗、分層護頰及環繞肩頸相近；沿用已定造型，頭盔配色依使用者更正與白灰身甲統一。

matches.integration_en: Fuse the original Star Warfare Pegasus with the observed Halo 5 Helioskrill helmet-and-collar language. Use matching off-white/light gray helmet and body armor, as corrected by the user on 2026-09-29, with a narrow dark V-shaped visor, two short brow points, broad pale shoulders, and sparse blue seam accents. Borrow the reference's layered cheek guards, human neck opening, articulated shoulder plates, and angled rib-protecting chest structure. Replace the single ornate swept crown with two much lower divided brow rails that grow out of Pegasus's own short points. Keep the visor continuous glass with a shallow central V; do not turn the face into eyes or a robotic muzzle. Rear structure may combine a newly shaped vertical central cover with two short side rails, informed by the documented Helioskrill rear concept but with a different panel sequence. Maintain normal human hands, soft joints and waist flexibility. Do not copy the purple-gold coating, alien emblems, exact crest or decorative striping.

user_correction.feedback: Pegasus 頭盔應該是同色不是紅色的
user_correction.rule: 頭盔硬殼與身甲使用一致的白灰主色；深色面罩、黑色內襯與既有藍色身甲細節維持原方向。
user_correction.note: 舊擷取參考及其歷史記錄中可見紅盔，但此顏色不作為後續設計規範；原始擷取圖片不重繪。

matches.source_kind: Actual Halo: Reach / MCC game-asset capture; supplementary multi-view assembly by Durandal-217 using Bungie assets, explicitly not an official published turnaround.

observed.helmet: 圓而短的平眉頭盔，冠頂中央黑槽、厚包下顎、側面大圓耳座；玻璃面罩有明確框和深度，後腦由矩形橫條包覆。
observed.chest: CQC 展示組合胸甲呈厚環狀架，短腹板依次下收；兩側矩形肩片向外下方壓住上臂；腋下、腰部和肘膝均有大幅軟衣。
observed.back: 資產多視圖有完整後方：左右長背板夾住中央上背凹槽，背中有四段短橫片，下方梯形腰後片。
observed.match_reason: Draco 的全灰黑、中央低冠稜、寬方護頰和折角肩，与 CQC 的無裝飾包覆盔及平矩形肩相近；人類軟衣與肩部固定可直接改善原輪廓。

matches.integration_en: Retain Draco's existing coal-gray/iron-gray body armor and layered shoulders. Redesign only the helmet with Destiny 2 Reverie Dawn Helm as reference: broad simple forehead, a very thin recessed horizontal sight slit, solid matte shield-shaped metal faceplate and short tucked chin. Keep cheek edge trim and modest ear seats integrated with Draco. No glass goggles, broad visor, dark vertical center stripe, elongated lower face, gold/white coating, ornaments or glowing eyes. CQC remains the retained body construction donor. B10 remains a separately colored backpack.

user_correction.feedback: Draco 的頭盔是沒有護目鏡那種的面罩的,我想可以改成天命2的那種頭盔風格的設計
user_correction.rule: 取消玻璃護目鏡／大片鏡片；以 Destiny 2 封閉金屬面甲為參考，維持 Draco 灰黑配色與既有身甲。
user_correction.note: 原擷取圖保留作輪廓參考；黑色前片不再據此推定為玻璃。未重新驗證原遊戲材質。
user_correction.follow_up_feedback: 不太對換一個天命的頭盔參考

helmet_override.application: 寬額低冠、細窄水平視孔、盾形不透明鐵灰面甲與收短下巴；煤灰側頰包框銜接小圓耳座，取消大片玻璃護目鏡與中央深色縱條。

observed.helmet: 從額冠到尖收下顎的多面切角殼；面前 V 形發光窗框，側面有兩條短平行亮條，沒有外伸巨角。
observed.chest: 胸甲由多塊斜向尖切片向中央集中；肩外側短三角甲片，高後頸護框；四肢仍是包在人類軟衣外的分片甲。
observed.back: 同張製作模型圖提供全身後视：中線三個向下的 V 形／箭形層板，左右高短肩後柱，腰後小独立護板。
observed.match_reason: Phoenix 的尖翼冠、折線黑面罩、青藍線與分裂胸片，與 Venator 的 V 形面部及胸背斜切板相近；其穿戴結構能壓低原款過高的尖角。

matches.integration_en: Fuse original Star Warfare Phoenix with the observed Halo 4 Venator facet construction. Keep Phoenix's charcoal blue-violet armor, broad black visor with sparse cyan angular lines, two outward swept crown wings, cyan shoulder insets and tiny burgundy forearm inserts. Borrow Venator's angled cheek planes, compact segmented chest facets, short rear-collar pylons and a readable vertical sequence of back plates. Preserve a real continuous smoked-glass visor underneath the new brow instead of copying a sealed robotic Venator face. Reduce the original crown wings to low backward-swept armored tabs with rounded safety edges; leave the paired direction visible. Consolidate glowing circuitry into the visor rim and two shoulder strips. Use two broad staggered back cover plates with an offset latch rather than the reference's repeated three-chevron spine. Keep human-fit boots and gloves, soft armpits and a flexible waist. Retain the original dark-blue/cyan identity, not Venator's olive or Raptor coating.

observed.helmet: 分層前突眉甲、斜向內收護頰、小型中央呼吸護塊；不採用原作身甲或配色。
observed.chest: 胸口上方兩塊高厚頸側板，下方黑色中央胸板；肩外端短翼片向外平展，前臂為緊貼手臂的長楔形。
observed.back: Paul Richards 多視原畫含後视與側面：左右後肩各一塊高短模組包圍中央深色水滴形小板，背腰分開，中下背留有軟衣空間。
observed.match_reason: Anubis 提供分層眉甲和斜收護頰；Cygni 短側翼及既有 Valkyrie 胸肩設計延續。金色微 T 玻璃由使用者選定融合稿定義。

rejected_alternative.reason: 已實看官方製作前後模型及 Halo 5 渲染；是可用參考，但外形較平整箱式，Valkyrie 的肩端短翼與內收呼吸罩更貼近 Cygni。

matches.integration_en: Retain the existing white-gray/forest-green/copper Cygni body armor, shoulder wings and Valkyrie-derived chest construction. Adopt the user-selected Anubis-inspired stepped brow and inward angular cheeks, reflective GOLD subtly T-shaped visor with broad eye band and medium-width central stem, compact chin and paired short rear-swept temple fins. Helmet shell matches the white-gray body. Remove the earlier purple visor, thick copper U frame and round cheek knobs; copper remains restrained trim. The selected concept is the helmet authority; supporting sheets must follow it.

user_correction.feedback: Cygni 也是頭盔跟身體顏色應該一致

user_correction.note: 原擷取圖只作輪廓參考；粉盔不是本次有效配色依據，未重新驗證原遊戲材質。

observed.chest: 宽 U 形大面胸框和圓弧頸口，兩側長肩帶；肩甲外片短尖，上臂與腹部保留大片黑色軟衣。
observed.back: 高模後视有兩個平行長後肩殼，中間低矮中央服務蓋，下缘共用圆弧下框；盔後有圓形接點與分節中線。

observed.match_reason: Andromedae 的圓冠、大面板、青色圓環，与 Oceanic 的圓耳座、圓弧護領和大玻璃窗相近；尤其可把原版實心假面變成明確有人佩戴的頭盔。

matches.integration_en: Fuse original Star Warfare Andromedae with the observed Halo 4 Oceanic round-shell and pressure-collar construction. Keep steel-blue main plates, deep navy undersuit, cyan segmented circles at the shoulders and one forearm, a rounded crown and a single central segmented crown channel. Borrow Oceanic's visible glass thickness, circular ear couplings, curved neck seal and wide open U-shaped chest support. Replace Andromedae's solid-looking face with a broad smoked-teal glass visor edged by a restrained cyan Y-shaped rim; do not copy Oceanic's exact full-height diving cage. Limit repeated circular graphics to three or four functional connector locations. Shape the back into two short low-profile side housings with one broad central service cover, informed by the documented high-poly back but with a different silhouette and seam layout. Keep the abdomen, inner arms and knees clearly fabric-covered and human. Retain the original blue/cyan palette instead of gold glass and exact Oceanic striping.

matches.source_kind: Halo 3 original game model render and directly ripped MCC armor menu graphic; supplementary actual MCC Halo 3 screenshot.

observed.helmet: 直立的高平冠，額部厚水平護板；小型雙玻璃眼窗，中央呼吸罩和兩側前突的短矩形呼吸管；頰側內凹，頭盔没有頭冠尖刺。
observed.chest: 厚實宽V/U胸框包住中央黑色胸口開口；肩殼是單塊圓鈍護片，下缘小長條燈；領圈低而寬。
observed.back: 已取得的確定 Halo 3 EOD 原圖皆為前面或前側，沒有確定的同款完整後视。不要把 Halo Reach EOD 頭盔圖或其他套裝背包当 Halo 3 EOD 背面。
observed.match_reason: Perseus 的高封閉頭盔與兩側呼吸濾器，可結合 EOD 的爆破防護面殼和清楚頸口；厚胸框補足承重結構，原 Perseus 多層肩甲應保留。

rejected_alternative.reason: Halo_EOD.jpg 實圖為 Reach 的三種 EOD 頭盔附件，非 Halo 3 EOD；已下載但不混入主款式。

matches.integration_en: User revision: restore and improve the ORIGINAL Star Warfare helmet as the primary design. Preserve the current redesigned body. Perseus must have a completely enclosed hard faceplate, tall faceted shell, converging pale branch lines and narrow orange crown stripe. No goggles, no horizontal glass eye band, no exposed eye windows. Halo remains a body and attachment construction donor, not the helmet authority.

user_direction_override.instruction: 使用者要求原Perseus封閉硬面甲，不要護目鏡；EOD僅供頸部與胸肩穿戴結構參考。

matches.initial_integration_en: Fuse original Star Warfare Perseus with the observed Halo 3 EOD protective helmet-and-chest construction. Preserve Perseus's charcoal green-black armor, sparse rust-orange trim, tall enclosed helmet silhouette, side breathing fittings and layered heavy shoulders. Borrow EOD's pressure-deflecting brow, recessed human glass eye band, compact paired respirator housings and strong chest yoke around a soft neck opening. Keep the face windows readable as smoked glass rather than illuminated robot eyes; combine them into a slim shallow band under the brow if needed. Translate Perseus's white branching face marks into two restrained etched frame lines and keep its orange crown strip narrow. Retain three overlapping shoulder layers but lower their height so the head can turn. There is no verified Halo 3 EOD rear view in this source set: design the new rear armor and backpack interface originally from the mapped Star Warfare source, and label those choices as new design. Maintain human hands, soft joints and a flexible waist.
